# Amul Sharma

> Amul Sharma is a Nepal-based BSc Information Technology student at ISMT College and a developer associated with CODE-WITH-AMUL. His primary technical direction is Python/Django backend software engineering combined with applied AI development, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), machine learning, and AI-enabled applications.

This site is the official portfolio of Amul Sharma. It documents his background, technical specialization, projects, and research.

## Technical Focus

- **Backend:** Python, Django, Django REST Framework, REST APIs, JWT authentication, RBAC, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite.
- **Applied AI:** Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), PEFT, embeddings, vector databases, AI-enabled web applications.
- **Machine Learning:** Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forest, KNN, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, SHAP, Optuna, cross-validation, ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, MCC.
- **Cloud & Infrastructure:** Microsoft Azure, Ubuntu, Nginx, Docker, GitHub, Render, Vercel.
- **Frontend (alongside backend):** React, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, HTML, CSS, JavaScript.

## Selected Projects

- **Job Sarathi** — Job-management and recruitment platform. Django backend, React/Vite/TypeScript frontend. [Repository](https://github.com/CODE-WITH-AMUL/jobSarathi)
- **PromtMarket** — Django web application deployed on Render. [Repository](https://github.com/CODE-WITH-AMUL/PromtMarket) · [Live](https://promtmarket.onrender.com)
- **ePharmacy** — Django-based pharmacy management system with role-based authentication.
- **FinCore** — ERP/accounting-oriented project concept for startups and small businesses.
- **Stock Prediction Portal** — Django and machine learning based stock analysis app. [Repository](https://github.com/CODE-WITH-AMUL/stock-prediction-portal)
- **Smart CCTV Surveillance System** — Python and OpenCV based real-time movement detection. [Repository](https://github.com/CODE-WITH-AMUL/visionsentinel)
- **Summary AI in Django** — NLP-based text summarization app. [Repository](https://github.com/CODE-WITH-AMUL/Summary-Ai-in-Django)
- **Social Coding Platform** — Collaborative platform for developers to share and review projects. [Repository](https://github.com/CODE-WITH-AMUL/social-coding-platform)
